newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gymboree raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gymboree raised to buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it has raised its rating on shares of Gymboree Corp to buy from hold and set a price target of $32.

-- In a statement, the investment firm said after a meeting with Gary White, the company's new chief executive officer, and Jim Curley, chief financial officer, it is "optimistic" about seeing "a more predictable, stable growth performance from the company."
-- Hambrecht & Quist noted the company's new computer inventory system and a management team that is "rejuvenated."
